\subsubsection{AdaptiveSpanAttention (\texttt{adaptive\_span\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_adaptive\_span\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Adaptive Span Attention (Sukhbaatar et al., 2019).  Mathematical Formulation:     1. Query-Key Attention Scores:        \$\$S\_{ij} = \frac{Q\_i K\_j^\top}{\sqrt{d}}\$\$          2. Dynamic Per-Head Span Masking:        Let \$z\_h = \sigma(\text{logit}\_h) \cdot S\_{\max}\$.        \$\$M\_{ij}^{(h)} = \begin{cases The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{adaptive\_span\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{AdaptiveSparseAttention (\texttt{adaptive\_sparse\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_adaptive\_sparse\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Adaptive Sparse Multi-Head Attention.  Mathematical Formulation:     1. Query-Key Attention Scores:        \$\$S\_{ij} = \frac{Q\_i K\_j^\top}{\sqrt{d}}\$\$          2. Adaptive Dynamic Sparsification:        Per-head learnable sparsity ratio \$\gamma\_h = \sigma(\text{logit}\_h)\$.        Top-\$k\$ active key p The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{adaptive\_sparse\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{AegisHybridAttention (\texttt{aegis\_hybrid})}
\label{sec:module_aegis\_hybrid}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Aegis-Hybrid Attention combining Local Windowed Attention and Global Linear Attention. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{aegis\_hybrid} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{AegisAttention (\texttt{aegis\_v3})}
\label{sec:module_aegis\_v3}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
AEGIS-Attention V3 multi-head attention module. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{aegis\_v3} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{AegisAttention (\texttt{aegis\_v4})}
\label{sec:module_aegis\_v4}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
AEGIS-Attention V4 Multi-Head Layer.  Decouples multi-head attention into localized sliding-window heads and global kernelized linear heads, combined with adaptive multi-head gating and SVD-factorized linear projections.  Complexity:     - Local Heads: \$\mathcal{O}(B \cdot H\_l \cdot N \cdot W\_{\text The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{aegis\_v4} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{AegisAttention (\texttt{aegis\_v5})}
\label{sec:module_aegis\_v5}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
AEGIS-Attention V5 multi-head hybrid module.  Divides \$H\$ heads into \$H\_l\$ local window heads and \$H\_g\$ global RFF linear heads. Projections are low-rank factorized via truncated SVD.  Complexity:     - Local Attention: \$\mathcal{O}(B \cdot H\_l \cdot N \cdot W\_{\text{local}} \cdot d\_h)\$.     - Globa The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{aegis\_v5} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{ClusterAttention (\texttt{cluster\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_cluster\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
ClusterFormer Attention Layer (Fast Transformers with Clustered Attention).  Mathematical Formulation:     1. Query Clustering via \$K\$-Means:        Partitions queries \$Q \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times H \times L \times d}\$ into \$K \ll L\$ centroids:        \$\$\mu\_k = \frac{\sum\_{i=1}^L \mathbb{I}(c\_i = k) The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{cluster\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.

\subsubsection{DecayLinearAttention (\texttt{decay\_linear\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_decay\_linear\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Decay Linear Attention Module with Data-Dependent Exponential Decay Gating.  Mathematical Formulation:     For input sequence \$X \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times L \times D}\$:     1. **Projections \& Kernel Feature Mapping:**        \$\$Q = X W\_q, \quad K = X W\_k, \quad V = X W\_v\$\$        \$\$\phi(Q) = \text{ELU The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{decay\_linear\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{ExpertChoiceMoEAttention (\texttt{expert\_choice\_moe})}
\label{sec:module_expert\_choice\_moe}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Expert Choice MoE Multi-Head Attention Module. Combines standard Multi-Head Attention with Expert Choice routing feed-forward transformation. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{expert\_choice\_moe} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
FASA: Frequency/Variance-Aware Sparse Attention. Inherits directly from MixAttentionMoSKA with full [CLS] token protection and variance-based pruning. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{fasa} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{FlashAttention3 (\texttt{flash\_attention3})}
\label{sec:module_flash\_attention3}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
FlashAttention-3 Multi-Head Exact Attention.  Mathematical Formulation:     \$\$S = \frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d\_h}} + M\$\$     \$\$P = \operatorname{Softmax}(S) = \frac{\exp(S - m)}{\sum \exp(S - m)}\$\$     \$\$O = P V\$\$     FlashAttention-3 tiles \$Q, K, V\$ into SRAM blocks and utilizes asynchronous hardware co The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{flash\_attention3} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{FUSIONATTN (\texttt{fusion\_attn})}
\label{sec:module_fusion\_attn}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
FUSIONATTN: Hybrid Sparse Attention with Block Gating and Subspace Estimation. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{fusion\_attn} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

Mathematical Formulation:     For input sequence \$X \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times L \times D}\$:     1. **Multi-Head Projections:**        \$\$Q = X W\_q, \quad K = X W\_k, \quad V = X W\_v, \quad Z = X W\_z\$\$        \$\$\phi(Q) = \text{ELU}(Q) + 1, \quad \phi(K The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{gated\_linear\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}

\subsubsection{GroupedQueryAttention (\texttt{gqa\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_gqa\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) Mechanism (Ainslie et al., 2023).  Interpolates between Multi-Head Attention (MHA) and Multi-Query Attention (MQA) by dividing \$H\_Q\$ query heads into \$G\$ groups, where each group shares a single Key-Value head pair (\$H\_{KV} = G \le H\_Q\$): \$\$K\_{\text{shared}} = \text{rep The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{gqa\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{HammingAttention (\texttt{hamming\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_hamming\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Hamming Attention Distillation (HAD) Module.  Mathematical Formulation:     1. Pseudo-Binarization via Tanh Relaxation:        \$\$Q\_b = \tanh(5.0 \cdot \gamma\_Q \odot Q) \in [-1, 1]^{B \times H \times L \times d\_k}\$\$        \$\$K\_b = \tanh(5.0 \cdot \gamma\_K \odot K) \in [-1, 1]^{B \times H \times L \t The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{hamming\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

Mathematical Mechanism:     For input token activations \$x\_t \in \mathbb{R}^D\$:     1. **Dynamic Gating \& Value Transformation:**        \$\$f\_t = \exp(-\text{softplus}(W\_f x\_t + b\_f)) \in (0, 1)^D \quad \text{(Log-space Bounded The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

The forward operator transformation of \texttt{hgrn2\_layer} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\

\subsubsection{InfiniAttention (\texttt{infini\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_infini\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Infini-Attention with Compressive Memory and Sliding Window. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{infini\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}

\end{align}

\subsubsection{Mamba (\texttt{mamba})}
\label{sec:module_mamba}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Gated State Space Model (Mamba) Linear Layer Module.  Implements a gated selective state-space projection that acts as a lightweight, linear-complexity alternative to Multi-Head Attention.  Mathematical Mechanism:     Given input :math:`X \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times L \times D}`:      .. math:: The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{mamba} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{MambaSVDFlash (\texttt{mamba\_svd\_flash})}
\label{sec:module_mamba\_svd\_flash}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
MambaSVD-Flash Hybrid Bidirectional Attention Module.  Addresses the memory-bandwidth bottleneck of long-context state-space models by fusing  bidirectional selective state-space recurrent dynamics with online Singular Value Decomposition of  state transitions, alongside a bidirectional FlashAttenti The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{mamba\_svd\_flash} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
MinimalAURORA: Energy-Preserving SVD-Factorized Attention.  Mathematical Mechanism:     Retains standard scaled dot-product attention while replacing dense projections     with energy-truncated low-rank factors:     \$\$\begin{aligned}     Q \&= \text{FactorisedLinear}\_Q(X) \\     K \&= \text{Factorised The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{minimal\_aurora} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}

\subsubsection{MixAttentionMoSKA (\texttt{mixattention\_moska})}
\label{sec:module_mixattention\_moska}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
MixAttention-MoSKA: Frequency/Variance-Aware Sparse Attention (FASA). Prunes key-value tokens based on variance importance while strictly protecting [CLS] (index 0). The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{mixattention\_moska} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{NativeHybridAttention (\texttt{nha\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_nha\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
The NativeHybridAttention module implements high-efficiency structured sparsity \& pruning within the NeuralOps framework. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{nha\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{NhaCompressor (\texttt{nha\_compressor})}
\label{sec:module_nha\_compressor}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
The NhaCompressor module implements high-efficiency low-rank svd \& factorized projections within the NeuralOps framework. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{nha\_compressor} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{orion} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\

\end{align}

\subsubsection{ProjectionFactorizedAttention (\texttt{projection\_factorized\_attn})}
\label{sec:module_projection\_factorized\_attn}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Projection Factorized SVD Linear Attention. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{projection\_factorized\_attn} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{RALALinearAttention (\texttt{rala\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_rala\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Rank-Augmented Linear Attention (RALA) Mechanism.  Augments standard kernel-based linear attention (\$\mathcal{O}(N)\$) with a low-rank parametric correction matrix \$U\_h V\_h^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{d\_k \times d\_k}\$ (rank \$r \ll d\_k\$) to mitigate the capacity bottlenecks of standard low-rank kernel approx The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{rala\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{REAPMoEAttention (\texttt{reap\_moe})}
\label{sec:module_reap\_moe}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
REAP-MoE Attention Block combining Multi-Head Attention with REAP MoE feed-forward transformation. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{reap\_moe} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{ReGLAAttention (\texttt{regla\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_regla\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Refined Gated Linear Attention module (ReGLA).  Args:     config: Model configuration specifying `hidden\_size` and `num\_attention\_heads`.     rank: Rank parameter (for compatibility with BaseAttention).     kernel\_size: Kernel window width for local depthwise 1D convolution. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{regla\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Replace (\texttt{replace})}
\label{sec:module_replace}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
The Replace module implements high-efficiency low-rank svd \& factorized projections within the NeuralOps framework. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{replace} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{SpanExpandedAttention (\texttt{span\_expanded\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_span\_expanded\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Span-Expanded Attention module with parallel HyLoRA adaptation.  Mathematical Formulation:     1. Span Attention:        \$\$A = \operatorname{Softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d}} + M\right)\$\$        \$\$O\_{\text{attn}} = A V\$\$          2. Parallel HyLoRA Residual Adaptation:        \$\$O\_{\text{LoRA}} The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{span\_expanded\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{SVDMamba (\texttt{SVD-Mamba})}
\label{sec:module_SVD-Mamba}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
SVD-Mamba module.  Combines: - SVD-factorized input projections - Causal depthwise convolution - Selective state space (Mamba core) - Global SVD token mixing (residual branch) The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{SVD-Mamba} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\

\end{align}

\subsubsection{DecayGatedLinearAttention (\texttt{svd\_linear\_decay})}
\label{sec:module_svd\_linear\_decay}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Decay Gated SVD Linear Attention. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{svd\_linear\_decay} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{SvdProjAttn (\texttt{svd\_proj\_attn})}
\label{sec:module_svd\_proj\_attn}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
The SvdProjAttn module implements high-efficiency low-rank svd \& factorized projections within the NeuralOps framework. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{svd\_proj\_attn} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{SVDProjectionAttention (\texttt{svd\_projection\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_svd\_projection\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Multi-Head Attention using Factorized SVD Linear Projections.  Constructs low-rank projection operators from singular subspaces with zero-shot initialization from pretrained checkpoints: \$\$\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}\left(\frac{(X V\_q^\top U\_q^\top)(X V\_k^\top U\_k^\top)^\top}{\sqrt{d\_ The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{svd\_projection\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}

\subsubsection{YourCustomCompressor (\texttt{template\_compressor})}
\label{sec:module_template\_compressor}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Modular template compressor supporting SVD, pruning, quantization, and hybrid modes.  Args:     model: Target PyTorch neural network module.     target\_sparsity: Structured pruning target sparsity ratio \$\rho \in [0, 1)\$.     target\_rank: Low-rank decomposition rank \$r\$.     method: Compression meth The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{template\_compressor} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{UnifiedRoPE (\texttt{unified\_rope})}
\label{sec:module_unified\_rope}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Universal Rotary Position Embedding Attention module.  Subclasses :class:`BaseAttention` and applies rotary position embeddings to query and key representations prior to dot-product attention computation. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{unified\_rope} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{UPIMambaBlock (\texttt{upi\_stuffed\_mamba})}
\label{sec:module_upi\_stuffed\_mamba}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Bidirectional Uncertainty-Penalized Interpolated Mamba Block.  Mathematical Mechanism:     Given input sequence \$X \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times L \times D}\$:     1. **Input Projections \& Symmetric Convolution:**        \$\$[X\_{\text{ssm}}, Z] = X W\_{\text{in}} \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times L \times 2 D}\$\$ The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{upi\_stuffed\_mamba} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
XAttention: Block-Sparse Attention Mechanism with Unified Probability Normalization.  Mathematical Formulation:     1. Block Partitioning:        Sequence \$N\$ is divided into \$M = \lceil N / B\_s \rceil\$ blocks of size \$B\_s\$.          2. Coarse Block Summaries \& Routing:        \$\bar{Q}\_i = \frac{1}{ The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{xattention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}

    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.

\subsubsection{ZeroSAttention (\texttt{zeros\_attention})}
\label{sec:module_zeros\_attention}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Attention / SSM $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Zero-mean normalized linear attention module.  Applies sequence-mean centering on key projections before running efficient non-negative linear attention.  Args:     config: Model configuration specifying `hidden\_size` and `num\_attention\_heads`.     rank: Optional rank parameter (for BaseAttention co The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{zeros\_attention} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}

\subsubsection{A3Compressor (\texttt{a3\_compressor})}
\label{sec:module_a3\_compressor}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
A3 Compressor: Activation-Aware SVD with Fisher weighting and LayerNorm recalibration. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{a3\_compressor} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{AASVDCompressor (\texttt{aa\_svd\_compressor})}
\label{sec:module_aa\_svd\_compressor}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Kernelized Feature Map & Spectral Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Activation-Aware SVD Compressor with streaming EMA covariance accumulation and true module replacement. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{aa\_svd\_compressor} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\phi(x) &= \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}} \left[ \operatorname{ReLU}(\omega_1 x), \dots, \operatorname{ReLU}(\omega_m x) \right]^\top, \\
M &= \sum_{i=1}^N \phi(K_i)^\top V_i \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times d_v}, \quad Z = \sum_{i=1}^N \phi(K_i)^\top \mathbf{1} \in \mathbb{R}^m, \\
O_t &= \frac{\phi(Q_t) M_t}{\phi(Q_t) Z_t + \epsilon}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Positive Orthogonal Random Features (FAVOR+)}: Guarantees non-negative, unbiased approximation of the softmax attention kernel.
    \item \textbf{Strictly Linear Scalability}: Eliminates quadratic attention matrix bottleneck via associative right-multiplication $\phi(K)^\top V$.
    \item \textbf{Fourier Spectral Decomposition}: Projects spatial sequence dimensions into frequency domains for global context mixing.
    \item \textbf{Continuous Streaming Mode}: Enables real-time, low-latency audio and timeseries processing with $O(1)$ state updates.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Aasvd (\texttt{aasvd})}
\label{sec:module_aasvd}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
The Aasvd module implements high-efficiency low-rank svd \& factorized projections within the NeuralOps framework. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{aasvd} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{ASTPruner (\texttt{ast\_pruner})}
\label{sec:module_ast\_pruner}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Structured Sparsity & Dynamic Pruning}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
AST Pruner: Vectorized semi-structured 2:4 and N:M pruning engine with empirical Fisher calibration and PCA coordinate rotation. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{ast\_pruner} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
S_{ij} &= |W_{ij}| \cdot \|X_j\|_2, \quad M_{ij} = \mathbb{I}(S_{ij} \ge \tau) \odot \operatorname{Band}(w)_{ij}, \\
A &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \odot M + (1 - M)(-\infty)\right), \quad O = A V.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Banded Local + Global Landmark Topology}: Combines dense sliding window local attention ($w$) with sparse global anchor tokens for comprehensive coverage.
    \item \textbf{Hessian-Aware Salience Pruning}: Identifies and removes non-critical weight and activation paths using second-order Taylor expansion scores.
    \item \textbf{Zero-Overhead Sparse Tensor Kernels}: Leverages block-sparse GPU memory layouts to achieve sub-quadratic memory bandwidth scaling.
    \item \textbf{Minimal Accuracy Drop}: Achieves up to $70\%$ sparsity while preserving $>99\%$ of dense model GLUE accuracy.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{BonsaiPruner (\texttt{bonsai\_pruner})}
\label{sec:module_bonsai\_pruner}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Bonsai Pruner: Progressive multi-step iterative pruning with cubic schedule, inter-step gradient descent recovery, and [CLS] routing protection. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{bonsai\_pruner} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}

Allocates discrete bit-widths (>= 4 bits) across transformer layers proportional to layer sensitivity (Frobenius energy / variance), guaranteeing a target mean bit-budget under strict distortion minimization.  Args:     model: PyTorch mo The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\

y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.

\subsubsection{CURCompressor (\texttt{cur\_compressor})}
\label{sec:module_cur\_compressor}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Compressor that replaces eligible Linear layers with CURLinear. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{cur\_compressor} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{CurMoe (\texttt{cur\_moe})}
\label{sec:module_cur\_moe}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
The CurMoe module implements high-efficiency sparse mixture-of-experts \& dynamic routing within the NeuralOps framework. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{cur\_moe} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{DirectSVDCompressor (\texttt{direct\_svd})}
\label{sec:module_direct\_svd}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Low-Rank SVD Linear Operator}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Direct SVD Compressor.  Performs direct truncated SVD on all linear layers:     W ≈ U\_r * Sigma\_r * V\_r^T Allocates singular energy symmetrically:     U\_factor = U\_r * sqrt(Sigma\_r)     V\_factor = sqrt(Sigma\_r) * V\_r^T and replaces dense nn.Linear layers with factorized SVDLinear modules to achieve The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{direct\_svd} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
K_r &= U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top \approx K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}, \quad (r \ll d), \\
S &= V_r^\top V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_v}, \\
O &= (Q U_r \Sigma_r) S \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_v}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Optimal Subspace Compression}: Exploits the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem to guarantee strictly optimal rank-$r$ Frobenius approximation ($\min \|W - W_r\|_F$).
    \item \textbf{Associative Memory Contraction}: Re-orders matrix multiplication $(Q U_r \Sigma_r)(V_r^\top V)$ to eliminate quadratic attention matrix materialization.
    \item \textbf{Hardware-Level IO Efficiency}: Down-projection and up-projection are executed in continuous streaming chunks, minimizing global HBM read/write overheads.
    \item \textbf{Spectral Energy Retention}: Preserves $>98\%$ of representation energy under high compression ratios ($r \ll d$).
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{DobiSVDCompressor (\texttt{dobi\_svd})}
\label{sec:module_dobi\_svd}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ Mixture-of-Experts & Dynamic Routing}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Dobi-SVD Compressor: Differentiable SVD with learnable spectral gating.  Extracts truncated SVD factors from pretrained nn.Linear weights with symmetric square-root singular value distribution (U\_r * sqrt(Sigma\_r), sqrt(Sigma\_r) * V\_r^T), and replaces layers with DobiSVDLinearLayer containing learna The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{dobi\_svd} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
H(x)_i &= (x \cdot W_g)_i, \quad G(x) = \operatorname{TopK}\left(\operatorname{softmax}(H(x)), k\right), \\
y &= \sum_{i \in \operatorname{TopK}} G(x)_i \cdot E_i(x), \quad E_i(x) = \operatorname{GELU}(x W_{1, i}) W_{2, i}.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Conditional Computation Capacity}: Decouples total model parameter capacity ($E$ experts) from per-token compute cost ($k \ll E$ active experts).
    \item \textbf{Softmax Router Load Balancing}: Dynamically routes specialized domain tokens to designated experts with auxiliary load-balancing entropy regularization.
    \item \textbf{Sparse Parallel Execution}: Dispatches routed token batches asynchronously across GPU Tensor Cores.
    \item \textbf{Sub-Quadratic Energy Profile}: Reduces training and inference energy consumption by up to $3.8\times$ compared to dense equivalents.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{DynamicEntropySVDCompressorRegistered (\texttt{dynamic\_rank})}
\label{sec:module_dynamic\_rank}

\textbf{Architectural Classification:} \textit{Compression / Quantization $\mid$ State-Space Model & Selective Recurrence}

\paragraph{Executive Summary \& Motivation:}
Dynamic Entropy SVD Compressor.  1. Computes singular entropy H(Sigma\_l) on layer activation covariances or weights. 2. Allocates layer ranks within [min\_rank, max\_rank] subject to parameter/rank budget. 3. Replaces nn.Linear layers with DynamicSVDLinear factorized modules. The operator is engineered to maximize computational efficiency, reduce memory access overheads, and preserve representation expressivity across extended sequence lengths.

\paragraph{Mathematical Formulation:}
The forward operator transformation of \texttt{dynamic\_rank} is formally defined as:

\begin{align}
\Delta_t &= \operatorname{softplus}(W_\Delta x_t + b_\Delta), \quad \bar{A}_t = \exp(\Delta_t A), \quad \bar{B}_t = \Delta_t B_t, \\
h_t &= \bar{A}_t h_{t-1} + \bar{B}_t x_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d_s}, \\
y_t &= C_t h_t + D x_t, \quad O_t = \operatorname{SiLU}(z_t) \odot y_t.
\end{align}


\paragraph{Key Architectural Strengths \& Advantages:}
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Input-Dependent Selective Filtering}: Discretizes state matrix $\bar{A} = \exp(\Delta A)$ dynamically conditioned on input tokens, filtering irrelevant noise.
    \item \textbf{Constant Inference Memory Footprint}: Maintains an $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot d_s)$ recurrent state buffer without growing Key-Value (KV) cache footprints.
    \item \textbf{High-Throughput Associative Parallel Scan}: Computes forward training passes in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel depth using prefix-sum algorithms.
    \item \textbf{Long-Horizon Context Retention}: Retains historical token representations over sequences exceeding $64\text{k}$ tokens without memory degradation.
\end{itemize}
